Hi Samantha - thanks for the quick reply and the Acme template. Answers inline below.

On Tue, Aug 25, 2026 at 10:02 AM Samantha Cross <samantha.cross@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> 1) Stakeholders - confirmed: Rajiv is the economic buyer. Legal is Erin White (erin.white@acmehealth.com) and procurement is procurement@acmehealth.com. For audits, include John Davis (jdavis@acmehealth.com).

Confirmed - I've updated the stakeholder list and put John on the distribution.

> 2) Templates - I attached Acme's security intake template (acme_security_template.pdf) to this reply. If you can fill that one first, that will help our internal tracker.

We'll complete Acme's template first. I've added it to the shared folder (link below) and assigned Dev to start populating the sections on architecture and data flows.

> 3) SOC2 & evidence - yes please attach your SOC2 report. We will likely request a SOC2 auditor bridge letter for any gaps; will confirm after we review.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf. If you want, we can also provide the SOC2 auditor contact for a bridge letter - let us know and we'll include it in the drive.

> 4) Data flow question - can you confirm whether embeddings are: encrypted at rest and in transit, and if we can set retention windows (we need 90-day default, ability to shorten).

Short answers:
- Encryption: Yes - all customer embeddings and token streams are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+/recommended) and at rest (AES-256).
- Retention: Retention windows are configurable per-customer; default retention for embeddings in hosted setups is 90 days, and we can shorten that to meet Acme's policy or implement automatic deletion requests.

> 5) NDA - we can execute an NDA if required; can you send your standard mutual NDA?

Sending DocuSign NDA link: https://www.docusign.com/na/en/document/XYZ-nda-acme-redwood (attached in related links). We can also sign your standard if you prefer.

> 6) Timeline - Wednesday 8/26 afternoon works for Samantha and John for a 60-minute technical deep-dive. Rajiv prefers to join the first 30 minutes.

We'll hold Wed 8/26 1:30-2:30pm PT as tentative (Rajiv join 1:30-2:00). Dev Patel will present the architecture & network requirements; I'll cover the questionnaire and evidence items.

Shared folder (temporary evidence workspace): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4D5E_shared-security-evidence
